description: This file contains a class implementing Drupal hook functions for toolbar theming and preprocessing, including hook_theme, hook_preprocess_HOOK for HTML, and methods for preparing toolbar variables.

classes.name: ToolbarThemeHooks
classes.description: Implements Drupal hook functions for toolbar theming and preprocessing.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Defines theme hooks for toolbar and menu.

methods.name: preprocessToolbar
methods.description: Prepares variables for toolbar template rendering, including trays, tabs, and other elements.

methods.name: preprocessHtml
methods.description: Adds class to HTML attributes if user has permission to access toolbar.
